envelope.description: Narrow the roll-up to unreadable heads of the counted kind

body.title: Narrow the roll-up to unreadable heads of the counted kind
body.summary: In countedChildren, throw UnreadableChildError only for unreadable ids whose id kind equals the counted kind (and for counted children whose status cannot be read); ignore unreadable heads of other kinds. Keep the signature and the strict scan. Add the ac1 tests through rollUp, using the inline reader(children, statuses, unreadable) factory of lifecycle-rollup.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: An unreadable head of a kind other than the counted kind does not block a Story roll-up
An unreadable head of the counted kind still blocks the roll-up with UnreadableChildError
countedChildren keeps its signature and stays unexported

tests.name: lifecycle-rollup.test.ts: an unreadable head of another kind does not block a Story roll-up
lifecycle-rollup.test.ts: an unreadable head of the counted kind still blocks the roll-up
